name: Kasa-obake
description: A whimsical Japanese yōkai depicted as an old paper umbrella that has come to life, characteristically bearing a single eye, a long lolling tongue, and a single sandaled leg on which it hops about.
origin: Kasa-obake is a creature of Japanese popular folklore and art; it is not localized to a particular region but is associated broadly with Edo-period urban culture and tsukumogami traditions.
